record.Description:
Everything in Standard: Includes all alerts and features of the Standard plan.
Event Video History: Extended to 60 days of event-based clips.
Continuous 24/7 Recording: Adds 10 days of continuous video history for wired cameras.
Advanced Gemini AI: Enhanced features like AI-generated video descriptions and a "Daily Summary" of activity at home.
History Search: Ability to "Ask Home" specific questions about past events (e.g., "What time did the delivery truck arrive?") using generative AI.
record.Name: Google Home Premium Advanced
